integrity: Exact proof of finite generating function, sharp total-variation identities and asymptotic regimes; independent Markov-state arithmetic verification of 55 finite path instances. Numerical checks alone do not prove asymptotic claims.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-vertex cuts on a deterministic path; one source and two endpoint targets; no extension to general graphs or to multiple sources. Historical priority beyond inspected papers remains uncertain.
title: Exact two-target path separation: a finite Bernoulli decomposition and boundary crossover
